contexts.text: (Isaac) was weaned () = the separation of the merely human Rational. AC 2649. See also AC 2341:4.
To be weaned = to be separated, as infants are from their mothers' breasts.
A child, a suckling, and a weaned child = (three degrees of the good of innocence).

The weaned child shall put his hand on the basilisk's den () = that those who are in the good of love to the Lord, have not the slightest fear of the evils and falsities which are from Hell, because they are protected by the Lord. AE 581:5.
